name: PCGS (Progressive Compression of 3D Gaussian Splatting)
definition: A progressive compression framework for 3D Gaussian Splatting that jointly and adaptively controls both the quantity and quality of Gaussians (or anchors) to enable effective progressivity for on-demand applications, allowing incremental bitstreams to refine fidelity.
summary: PCGS is a progressive compression framework for 3D Gaussian Splatting that jointly controls anchor quantity and quality to enable on-demand fidelity refinement via incremental bitstreams.
